observations: Photo 0: A black, cone-shaped standing hair dryer with a control panel on the front. The brand 'WAVE' is visible on the front panel. The unit is mounted on a tall, adjustable metal pole with a black base. The setting appears to be a salon with mirrors and chairs in the background.

Photo 1: Same unit from a slightly different angle, showing the interior of the cone with small holes, likely for air distribution. The base is a three-legged stand with clear plastic feet. A cardboard box is visible beneath the unit.

Photo 2: Side view of the unit, showing the adjustable tilt mechanism and the full height of the stand. The base has three legs with caster wheels for mobility. The background shows a storage area with boxes and salon equipment.
The unit has a digital control panel with multiple buttons and icons, suggesting multiple settings.
The seller claims it has 'infrared light for hair' — no visible infrared light source is shown in any photo.
The unit appears to be in good condition, with no visible damage or wear.

No infrared light source is visible in any photo. The control panel has icons, but none are labeled or clearly indicate infrared function. No text or label confirms infrared capability.
